articles.title: ADNOC to Become 1st Energy Firm to Deploy OpenAI Frontier
articles.description: Under a partnership agreement, ADNOC will open up its proprietary industrial data to OpenAI models for the development of intelligence capabilities using G42's AI infrastructure in the UAE.

articles.title: ADNOC Greenlights Abu Dhabi Upstream Gas Project
articles.description: ADNOC announced a final investment decision to proceed with what it said is its first large-scale unconventional natural gas project.

articles.title: US, Iran Study Proposals amid Limited Strikes
articles.description: Iran and the U.S. are reviewing the latest proposals from mediators on how to bridge their divides and avert another round of all-out war, according to a diplomat briefed on the matter.

articles.title: Kistos to acquire 30% stake in North Sea’s Abbey and Baker gas fields
articles.description: Kistos signed a binding farmout agreement under which its wholly owned subsidiary, Kistos Energy, will acquire a 30% non-operated working interest in the Abbey and Baker gas developments in the UK Southern North Sea.

articles.title: XRG to Buy Shell Stake in Australian LNG Project
articles.description: Shell agreed to sell its 16.67 percent stake in the North West Shelf Project, which produces liquefied natural gas and domestic gas in Western Australia, to ADNOC's XRG.

articles.title: San Mateo signs two natural gas deals in Northern Delaware Basin
articles.description: Matador Resources announced that its subsidiaries within San Mateo Midstream signed two agreements in the Northern Delaware Basin, New Mexico.

articles.title: Dubai Benchmark Slips Into Contango for the First Time Since July
articles.description: The curve of the Dubai benchmark is showing signs that rising oil flows from the Middle East are exceeding demand for the first time since early July, when the three-week U.S.-Iran ceasefire allowed millions of barrels to leave unhindered the Strait of Hormuz. Physical flows have been gradually rising for the past two months as Gulf producers accelerated shuttle-shipping through Hormuz with ship-to-ship (STS) transfers in the Gulf of Oman, once tankers have cleared the chokepoint. articles.title: U.S. Launches Secret Strikes on Iran Ahead of Midterm Elections
articles.description: The United States struck Iran's strategic Qeshm Island on November 2, US officials confirmed, in the latest in a series of previously undisclosed military operations against Iran that have continued even as President Donald Trump plays down the prospect of renewed large-scale fighting. The strikes come just hours before the November 3 US midterm elections and follow a shift in Trump’s public rhetoric. After weeks of warning that Washington could resume a major military campaign against Tehran after the vote, the president ruled out an immediate…

articles.title: Aramco Logs 9 Pct Higher Profit
articles.description: Aramco posted a nine percent increase in third-quarter profit after a jump in earnings from its refineries and as the Iran war drove oil prices higher.

articles.title: Blackstone-led group to invest $3.1bn in Mitsubishi’s LNG Canada stake
articles.description: A Blackstone-led investor group has agreed to invest $3.1bn for a 49.9% stake in a subsidiary holding Mitsubishi's interest in the LNG Canada project.

articles.title: Indian Refiner BPCL Buys U.S. WTI Crude Oil Cargo
articles.description: Bharat Petroleum Corporation Limited (BPCL), one of the biggest Indian state-owned refiners, has bought 1 million barrels of U.S. West Texas Intermediate crude, trade sources told Reuters on Tuesday, as India looks to procure cheaper cargoes amid freight rates easing from the record highs hit in early October. BPCL has bought the cargo for delivery at Mumbai in late December-early January, paying a premium of some $18 per barrel over Dated Brent, according to Reuters' sources. Last week, BPCL said it would reduce its purchases of crude oil from…

articles.title: ADNOC Gas to Supply LNG to TotalEnergies Under Five-Year Deal
articles.description: ADNOC Gas will supply up to 1.6 million tons of LNG to TotalEnergies over the next five years under an agreement announced on Tuesday by the gas unit of Abu Dhabi’s state energy firm and the French supermajor. The first LNG deliveries will begin as early as this year, said TotalEnergies, which is one of the world’s biggest LNG traders. “Thanks to its perfect location between Europe and Asia, this new supply will enable TotalEnergies to confirm its position as one of the main LNG portfolio suppliers,” said Stéphane…

articles.title: Shell Sells North West Shelf LNG Stake to Abu Dhabi's XRG for $1.45 Billion
articles.description: Shell is selling its 16.67% non-operated interest in the North West Shelf LNG project in Australia to the United Arab Emirates’ XRG for US$1.45 billion as part of its strategy to disciplined capital allocation and portfolio choices. Shell on Tuesday announced that its wholly-owned subsidiary Shell Australia Pty Ltd has signed an agreement to sell its 16.67% non-operated interest in the North West Shelf (NWS) project to wholly owned subsidiaries of XRG for a base consideration of US$1.45 billion, subject to customary adjustments, plus an additional…

articles.title: Saudi Aramco Profit Beats Expectations as Oil Prices Soar
articles.description: Saudi Aramco beat analyst estimates of its third-quarter profit as higher crude oil and fuel prices offset the impact of oil supply disruptions due to attacks on its assets. The Saudi state oil giant on Tuesday reported an adjusted net income of $31.2 billion for the third quarter, up from $28.6 billion for the same period last year, and easily beating a $28.7-billion analyst consensus estimate compiled by Bloomberg. Despite the attacks on the East-West onshore oil pipeline bypassing the Strait of Hormuz and other attacks on Aramco infrastructure…

articles.title: CVR Energy Nears $4 Billion Refinery Deal With Marathon
articles.description: Marathon Petroleum is nearing a deal for the sale of several refineries to CVR Energy, with the sale expected to be worth $4 billion, the Wall Street Journal has reported, citing unnamed sources. The deal could be announced later today. The refining sector has become the star of the oil industry this year as the wars in the Persian Gulf and Russia-Ukraine have severely crippled global fuel supply, prompting refiners outside the war zones to boost their output. The market situation has driven a surge in refining margins to all-time highs, making…

articles.title: U.S. LNG Exports Near Record High as Europe Scrambles for Winter Supply
articles.description: Exports of liquefied natural gas from the United States hit their second-highest level in history thanks to an uptick in demand from Europe ahead of the start of the winter season, which drove LNG prices higher. According to LSEG data cited by Reuters, U.S. exports of liquefied gas to Europe rose by 1 million tons last month, to a total of 6.89 million tons. Exports to Asia, meanwhile, remained almost unchanged, slightly down from the previous month, at 2.73 million tons, compared to 2.84 million tons in September. Europe has become the biggest…

articles.title: Oil Prices Bounce Back Following Reports of U.S. Strikes on Iran
articles.description: After shedding 7% yesterday, crude oil prices inched up earlier today following a Wall Street Journal report about a U.S. strike on Iran’s Qeshm Island. Brent crude traded at $105.26 per barrel at the time of writing, and West Texas Intermediate traded at $97.07 per barrel, after the WSJ cited unnamed U.S. officials as saying Iran’s Qeshm Island became a target in what they said was the latest in a series of “ limited strikes Washington has secretly carried out” over the past few weeks on Iran. articles.title: Oil Prices Sink as Iran Signals Talks
articles.description: Oil prices plunged more than 7% as Washington and Tehran signaled openness to renewed peace negotiations.

articles.title: Questions Mount Over Venezuela’s Biggest Oil Deal
articles.description: “The biggest oil deal in world history” between the Trump Administration and North American Blue Energy Partners may not live up to the hype as the privately held and previously little-known company could face steep challenges in developing Venezuela’s huge oil resources, Reuters reported, citing more than a dozen oil workers, contractors, and experts from the industry. articles.title: Germany Misses Gas Storage Target as Prices Soar
articles.description: Germany has missed its gas storage target for the start of winter. Now, the EU’s largest economy faces a difficult heating season as the European gas benchmark topped 100 euros per MWh last week and has stayed there since. Higher prices may turn out to be the smaller problem. A supply crunch would be worse. Every European Union member state has an obligation to secure enough natural gas ahead of winter to fill 80% of storage capacity. Germany has failed to do that, only filling its storage to about 61%. articles.title: Africa Launches Its Own Oil Bank as Western Lenders Retreat
articles.description: Africa now has a bank built to finance the oil and gas projects Western banks and development lenders have dropped under their climate commitments. Afreximbank and the African Petroleum Producers’ Organization (APPO) formally established the Africa Energy Bank (AEB) at its inaugural general meeting in Abuja on October 31. That was more than four years after the two institutions began work on it and some 20 months behind schedule. Abuja beat bids from six countries, including Ghana, Algeria, South Africa and Benin, to host the bank.…

articles.title: Trump Threatens Vetoes if Democrats Win
articles.description: President Donald Trump said he may have to become 'Mr. Veto' if Democrats win a majority in the midterms.

articles.description: Polls open Tuesday with prediction markets already leaning one way, as Polymarket traders were pricing a Democratic sweep of both chambers at about 71 percent, a Democratic House with a Republican Senate at 24 percent and a Republican sweep at 5 percent. articles.description: TotalEnergies agreed to acquire a 30 percent operating stake in the SK410B Lang Lebah and B14 gas fields off the coast of the Malaysian state of Sarawak.
